sources.name: City of Corona Open Expenditures (CorStat)
sources.note: Corona Fire Department (department 30) payment lines, including pension and benefit payments; FY2026 partial (payments through 2026-06-30)

sources.name: Open FI$Cal department vendor transactions (CAL FIRE)
sources.note: CAL FIRE (state fire agency, business unit 3540), whole department: fire protection, State Fire Marshal and resource management; lines summed per voucher, payee, account, fund, program and date; CalCard purchases appear as payments to US Bank; the State publishes employee travel and training reimbursements to CONFIDENTIAL; FY2026 partial (postings through 2026-06-30)

sources.name: Checkbook L.A. (Los Angeles City Controller)
sources.fiscal_year: City of Los Angeles FY, Jul-Jun
sources.note: Los Angeles Fire Department (department 38) invoice lines; cancelled checks are negative lines; the City publishes most refunds of ambulance and fire service charges to PRIVACY-FIRE instead of the payee; purchases other City departments make for Fire are not included; FY2027 partial (payments through 2026-09-09)

sources.name: City of Moreno Valley Open Expenditures
sources.fiscal_year: City of Moreno Valley FY, Jul-Jun
sources.note: Moreno Valley Fire Department (departments Fire Operations, Fire Prevention and Fire - Office of Emergency Mgmt) invoice lines; most dollars are the City's contract payments to the County of Riverside for fire staffing (CAL FIRE operated); purchases other City departments make for Fire are not included; FY2026 partial (payments through 2026-06-24)

sources.name: County of Riverside Check Book (Riverside County Fire Department)
sources.note: County Fire Department (department Fire Protection) accounts-payable lines with a vendor; payroll, journal entries and internal charges are not included; the largest payee is the State (CAL FIRE) for contract staffing; FY2027 partial (lines through 2026-08-26)

sources.name: California State Controller, City Financial Transactions Reports (fire function)
sources.note: One annual total per city: current expenditures of the Fire function (operations only; capital outlay, debt service and the separate Emergency Medical Services line are not included); linked only to the city's own fire department; no vendors. FY2024 (2023-24) is the latest year the SCO has published

sources.name: California State Controller, Special Districts Financial Transactions Reports
sources.note: Annual expenditure totals by report line (salaries, benefits, services and supplies, capital outlay, debt service) as filed by fire protection districts and fire authority JPAs; no vendors. FY2024 (2023-24) is the latest year the SCO has published

sources.name: SCPRS Purchase Order Data (CAL FIRE purchase orders)
sources.note: CAL FIRE (state fire agency) purchase order lines with quantity, unit price and UNSPSC commodity; FY2012-13 to FY2014-15 only (the State publishes no later bulk extract); purchase order amounts, not payments; no brand field

sources.name: San Francisco Vendor Payments (Vouchers)
sources.fiscal_year: City and County of San Francisco FY, Jul-Jun
sources.note: Fire Department (FIR) voucher lines, amounts paid; the Controller removes payments to employees, jurors, witnesses, refunds, judgments and claims before publishing; purchases other departments make for Fire are not included; FY2027 partial (data loaded 2026-10-05)
